item.title: Free Vibe Coding Workshop Series Teaches AI-Driven Software Creation
item.description:
Free Vibe Coding Workshop Series Teaches AI-Driven Software Creation

WIT // HSV and ARC are hosting a free, three‑part Vibe Coding Workshop Series that shows participants how to turn natural‑language prompts into working software using AI‑powered code generators.

🔍 Overview

  • Hands‑on, immersive workshops (not lectures) that guide AI tools to generate, iterate, and improve code.
  • Series consists of three 2‑hour modules for a total of 6 hours of instruction.
  • Open to professionals, students, educators, creators, and curious minds.

🧩 How it works

  • Vibe coding lets you build functional software simply by describing intent in natural language.
  • Participants will explore cloud‑native AI app builders to turn ideas into interactive applications without writing code manually.
Platform Role
Lovable Cloud‑native AI app builder
Bolt.new Cloud‑native AI app builder
Google AI Studio Cloud‑native AI app builder
  • The curriculum advances from browser‑based low‑code platforms and AI agents, to cloud development environments with controlled code customization, and finally to fully local setups with open‑source tools and LLM architectures.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Free to attend – no cost for participants.
  • Open to all – no prerequisites or prior coding experience required.
  • Bring your own laptop – required for the fully immersive experience.
  • Certificate of Completion – awarded to attendees who complete all three workshops (a valuable addition to a resume or LinkedIn profile).
  • Workshop schedule:
    • Prompt to Prototype – 10/8
    • Collaborative Cloud Coding – 10/22
    • Owning Your Code – 11/12
  • Spots are limited and fill fast.

🚀 Availability

  • Register now to secure a spot; the event is free and open to everyone.
  • 👉 For more information on the three‑part workshop series, click here.

💡 Why it matters

  • The barrier between having an idea and building something that works is disappearing.
  • Natural language is becoming a development interface thanks to AI‑powered platforms and coding agents.
  • The next generation of builders will be defined by the ability to clearly describe what should be built, not by years of programming experience.
  • Vibe coding is changing who can create software.

#AIWorkshop #VibeCoding #LowCode #AItools

Source: VIBE CODING ESSENTIALS - Workshop 1 : Prompt to Prototype

item.title: AI‑Powered Rapid Landing Page Creation Showcased at Startplatz AI Hub Event
item.description:
AI‑Powered Rapid Landing Page Creation Showcased at Startplatz AI Hub Event

An AI‑focused meetup took place in Cologne, bringing together over 100 vibe coders and marketers each month (more than 2,000 since June 2025). Speakers demonstrated how AI can turn a vague brief into a functional landing page in minutes, and shared workflows for building web‑to‑app experiences without traditional development skills.

🔍 Overview

  • When: 18:30 – 21:00 CEST, doors open at 18:30, talks start at 19:00.
  • Where: Im Mediapark 5, 1st Floor, Room Barcelona, 50670 Cologne, Germany.
    • Transit: Media Park S‑Bahn station – 3 minute walk.
    • Parking: Synodome parking house.
  • Streaming: All sessions streamed live with HD audio and screen share. Register to receive a Zoom link. Talks are recorded and posted on pirateskills.com; participants may appear on video.

🗓️ Event Details

  • Community size: 100+ vibe coders and marketers join each month; 2,000+ participants since June 2025.
  • Organisers: Startplatz AI Hub (the epicenter of generative AI and innovation in Cologne) and Pirate Skills (growth‑marketing community offering courses and tools such as the Captain).
  • Format: Short talks followed by demos of AI‑assisted workflows.

🧑‍💼 Speakers & Topics

Time Speaker Talk Title & Focus
19:00 – 19:15 Ben Sufiani “From Web to App: Pirate Skills in Your Pocket” – built a web‑to‑app solution in a weekend without being a developer, using actions that agents and apps share.
— Christina Röse Non‑technical vibe‑coded the landing page for her wedding site bridesmaid.love, part of an agentic wedding planner she is building.
— Farzan Borhanazad Showed how to turn a vague brief into a polished website in a few hours using Codex, Claude, and design tricks like instant color/font swaps.
— Nurgul Aslan (IADM) Presented a risk‑management fix for AI tools: list, classify risk, assign owner, train, document; explained what the EU AI Act requires.

⚙️ Key Takeaways

  • Cost & speed: Avoid €15k MVP projects that take months; create landing pages in 15 minutes.
  • Analytics: Set up tracking yourself without additional services.
  • Automation: Use AI to handle repetitive tasks such as bug fixes, testing, and documentation.
  • Compliance: Follow EU AI Act guidance by cataloguing tools, assessing risk, and maintaining documentation.

🚀 How to Join the Community

  • Startplatz AI Hub: Free AI workshops, events, and community building – online and in Cologne.
  • Pirate Skills: Join the community, take Ben’s courses, or use tools like the Captain for growth marketing.
  • Registration: Sign up to receive the Zoom link and access live streams.

The event captured the practical potential of generative AI for rapid, low‑code web creation and highlighted compliance considerations for practitioners.

#AIEvents #NoCode #GrowthMarketing #EUAIAct

Source: Vibe Coding Cologne - October 7, 2026 | Free AI-Assisted Coding Meetup

item.title: Tokyo Fun Language Exchange – Multilingual Meetup in Tokyo
item.description:
Tokyo Fun Language Exchange – Multilingual Meetup in Tokyo

Welcome to Tokyo Fun Language Exchange – a regular meetup where participants practice a variety of languages in small groups.

🗓️ Overview

  • Official start time: 7.35 pm (arrive before 7.30 pm for name registration and payment).
  • Event fee: ¥1000.
  • Frequency: Events are held regularly; participants are encouraged to attend at least twice a month.
  • Group size: Four sessions of 25‑30 minutes each, with groups of two or three people. No large‑group sessions.

🌐 Languages Offered

Code Flag Language (English) Native name
JP 🇯🇵 Japanese 日本語
EN 🇬🇧 English 英語
CH 🇨🇳 Chinese (Mandarin) 中国語（北京語）
FR 🇫🇷 French フランス語
GER 🇩🇪 German ドイツ語
IT 🇮🇹 Italian イタリア語
KOR 🇰🇷 Korean 韓国語
POR 🇵🇹 Portuguese ポルトガル語
RUS 🇷🇺 Russian ロシア語
SP 🇪🇸 Spanish スペイン語

📋 Participation Guidelines

  • All abilities are welcome. Beginner? No problem.
  • No direct contact requests (Line, Facebook, Instagram, etc.) unless you have met several times.
  • If you wish to share information (e.g., webpage details), write it on paper.
  • The organiser will announce the language for you to practice; change language only to help explain something quickly.
  • You may need to act like a teacher if other participants are weaker.

📢 Organizer Role & Community Conduct

  • The organiser coordinates the event; the event succeeds based upon the attendees.
  • If you have an issue with another attendee, inform the organiser directly.
  • After the event, you may submit a review/evaluation; low evaluations impact the group.
  • Cancellation policy: Late cancellation (within 3 hours of start) or no‑show with non‑payment via PayPay within 24 hours may result in removal from the group.

📱 Contact & Channels

  • LINE: https://line.me/ti/p/yCc-xUZnFN – quote “language exchange helper - information please”.
  • Tokyo Fun Events open chat group on LINE
  • Tokyo Fun Events on Instagram
  • Tokyo Fun Events on Facebook
  • A team of regular participants may attend for a lower fee and sometimes receive some money; message on LINE for more information.

#LanguageExchange #TokyoEvents #Multilingual

Source: Ningyocho [JP / ENG / CH / FR / IT / SP] Multi Language Exchange, 2026年10月6日(火) 19:30 | Meetup

item.title: Free October AI Agent Meetup in Gulf Breeze

Free October AI Agent Meetup in Gulf Breeze

AutoEDU is hosting a free, in‑person AI Agent meetup this October for anyone who wants to see practical AI‑agent workflows and connect with local builders.

📅 Overview

  • In‑person at Gulf Breeze Cowork Annex, 3000 Gulf Breeze Pkwy, Gulf Breeze, FL 32563\
  • Duration: 2 hours\
  • No programming experience required; open to beginners\
  • Bring your questions, ideas, and, if you like, a laptop and charger

🛠️ What You’ll Experience

  • Plain‑English explanations for beginners\
  • Practical agents for small businesses, educators, creators, and everyday work\
  • Q&A with local builders and operators\
